goal: Measure a 5x5 grid at relative offsets over 0-0.4 mm (0.1 spacing) in X and Y from the current position, and make a 5x5 map marking positions whose similarity to the polystyrene reference spectrum is 0.85 or higher.

execution_summary.trajectory: Measured a 5x5 grid centered at (38.176, 25.553) with 0.1mm spacing. Analyzed the resulting spectra by interpolating them onto the reference library's Raman shift axis and calculating cosine similarity against the PS_01 reference spectrum.
execution_summary.outcome: Measured a 5x5 grid and found no positions with high similarity to the polystyrene reference spectrum.

lesson: When performing a material mapping based on similarity, normalize both measured and reference spectra to [0, 1] range before calculating cosine similarity to ensure scale-invariance. In this case, no polystyrene was detected in the scanned area.

system_metrics.metrics: Grid size: 5x5, Max similarity to PS: ~0.208 (below threshold 0.85)
